text:
inc-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> synth-check-prod-us-east-1 has 5 consecutive failures (threshold=3) :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: PD incident P-48721 created (high) - https://pagerduty.local/incidents/P-48721
miguel (oncall): acked P-48721 :white_check_mark: I'm on call for the hour, assigning to SRE lead
sasha (SRE): taking lead. first pass: are these real 500s from the model router or probe infra timeouts?
eli (platform): I saw a noisy deployment to the canary pool ~30m ago, rolling back in progress but may have left some agents in inconsistent state
tara (prod-eng): that rollout included a small change to connection timeout in prober config (timeout_ms -> 1200). it was intended to reduce flapping but maybe too aggressive.
zoe (cs): quick note from support — no customer reports so far, only internal synthetic alerts. low customer impact for now.
sasha (SRE): digging into the prober logs now. tail of prober stdout:
```
2024-10-12T14:01:12Z prober[pid=4123] ERROR http check /v1/health -> 503 {"route":"model-router-canary-3","latency_ms":32}
2024-10-12T14:01:13Z prober[pid=4123] ERROR http check /v1/health -> 502 {"route":"model-router-canary-2","latency_ms":128}
2024-10-12T14:01:14Z prober[pid=4123] WARN retrying request
```
sasha (SRE): looks like the canary model-router instances returning 5xx intermittently. pattern matches after the recent config roll.
miguel (oncall): can we triage quickly and reduce noisiness? PD is noisy for SREs during PTO.
sasha (SRE): mitigation proposal:
- pause canary fanout in synth-prober (will route checks to warm pool)
- silence P-48721 for 15m while we confirm stability
- if green, roll back the timeout change on prober agents, then re-run a small canary
eli (platform): agree. I'm pausing fanout now.
```
# command run by eli
kubectl -n monitoring patch configmap synth-prober --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/fanout_enabled","value":"false"}]'
```
inc-bot: synth-prober fanout_disabled (user=eli) — probes now routing to warm-pool (no-canary) :gear:
sasha (SRE): silencing PD P-48721 for 15m and acknowledging to stop repeated alerts
pagerduty-bot: P-48721 acknowledged by miguel (oncall). Notifications suppressed for 15m.
miguel (oncall): thanks. sasha, any quick signal I should watch?
sasha (SRE): watch: synth-check-success-rate, probe-5xx-rate, model-router-5xx-per-pod. I'll post updates.
(5m later)
sasha (SRE): immediate metrics: synth-check-success-rate recovered from 84% -> 99% after routing off canary. model-router 5xx reduced to baseline.
eli (platform): I just rolled back the prober timeout change to previous value on the configmap and restarted prober DaemonSet on affected nodes.
```
kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart daemonset/synth-prober
```
sasha (SRE): restarted prober pods, new pods show healthy checks. re-enabling a single canary shard for smoke test in 10m.
tara (prod-eng): digging into the deploy pipeline — that change slipped past the canary test due to missing coverage in the prober config unit test. I'll add a guard.
(20m later)
sasha (SRE): smoke test passed with single canary shard enabled, no 5xx observed. will slowly ramp; keeping monitoring on.
zoe (cs): CS confirms no customer impact and will update any open tickets if that changes.
miguel (oncall): removing PD suppression and closing the incident P-48721 (closing notes: routed off canary, rolled back config, restarted prober, monitoring green). filing post-incident action item for deploy pipeline test and runbook update.
sasha (SRE): incremental follow-ups assigned:
- MIGUEL: write short postmortem (synth probe noise -> P-48721) and link to logs (due EOD)
- TARA: add unit test/guard to deploy pipeline for prober config changes
- ELI: audit recent canary agent states and ensure no stale agents remain
- SASHA: update runbook with quick mitigation steps (pause fanout, re-route to warm pool, restart prober)
pagerduty-bot: P-48721 resolved by miguel (oncall).
miguel (oncall): closing thread, thanks everyone. :pray:
sasha (SRE): thanks — will follow up with the writeup and tag postmortem-channel.
